The RNNoise parity check is a dry run; controlled pipeline tests also check unchanged report/rendered WAV bytes with progress enabled.
Twenty-four optional/live tests were skipped; their cases are not claimed as passed.
Detailed report projections retain recorded evidence and remain verbose; fresh-agent suggestions are nonblocking usability feedback.
